title: Manim Calc
intro: Type a sum on the keys or the keyboard. Each answer comes with the written method that reaches it, worked on your numbers.
stage_empty: Press = to see the method for your sum here.
example_summary: {sum}, worked by the calculator's own rules and rendered with Manim.
examples_intro: The same steps for four fixed sums, rendered ahead of time with Manim.

player.failed: The animation could not load its files. Open this page through a web server, not from disk.

messages.too_many_digits: A number holds at most {max} digits. Press an operator or = to use this one.
messages.divide_by_zero: Dividing by zero has no answer. Delete the 0 and type another number.
messages.too_big: The answer would have more than {max} digits. Press C to start again.
messages.need_number: Type a number first, then the operator.
messages.need_second: Type the second number, then press =.

words.setup: Write {a} above {b}, lining up the ones.
words.minus_sign: Put a minus sign in front: the answer is {answer}.
words.add_last_carry: Write the carried {carry} at the front.
words.sub_leading_zero: {place}: {x} − {y} = {diff}. A zero at the front is left out.
words.sub_need: {place}: {x} is less than {y}, so borrow from the {from}.
words.sub_take: Take 1 from the {from}: {old} becomes {new}, and the {to} become {got}.
words.mul_shift: Multiply {a} by the {d} {place}: write {zeros} on the right, then {a} × {d} = {q}, so the row is {p}.
words.mul_zero_digit: The {place} digit is 0, so its row is 0.
words.div_setup: Write {a} under the bracket and {b} to its left.
words.div_skip: {cur} is less than {b}, so take the next digit too: {next}.
words.div_digit: {b} goes into {cur} {q} times: {q} × {b} = {p}. Write {q} on top.
words.div_zero_digit: {b} goes into {cur} 0 times. Write 0 on top.
words.div_bring: Bring down the {d}: the number to divide is now {cur}.
words.swap_sub: {b} is larger than {a}, so work {b} − {a} and give the answer a minus sign.
words.neg_mul: {a} is below zero, so multiply {size} and give the answer a minus sign.
words.neg_div: {a} is below zero, so divide {size} and give the quotient and the remainder a minus sign.
